basic_info.headline: Software Engineer at 3M Health Information Systems
basic_info.about:
I'm a graduate from Neumont University and I've worked with a number of technologies on various different projects both as assignments for school and during internships with different companies. I've primarily worked with Java and C#, with some experience in Node.js and JavaScript, but I enjoy learning new technologies, and experiencing different ways of thinking from my colleagues.

Technical Experience:

➤ Two years experience in Java development
➤ Two years experience in C# development
➤ Experience working with a Microservice oriented application architecture
➤ Experience creating web applications using J2EE (Java Servlets)
➤ Experience creating web applications using ASP.NET MVC or WebApi
➤ Experience utilizing the .NET Entity Framework to interact with a database from a web or desktop app 
➤ Experience designing and creating SQL databases schemas
➤ Experience with NoSQL Databases like Mongo, Cassandra, and Riak.

location.full: North Salt Lake, Utah, United States

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
experience.description: Utilized .NET WepAPI 2, OWIN, Angular.js, and other technologies in a microiservices architecture to build a status board displaying the status of on going repairs in a dealership. Customers waiting for their vehicles to be repaired can look at StatusPoint to  get a celar idea of where their vehicle is in the repair process.

experience.title: QA Automation Intern
experience.description: Increased the amount of test coverage for their front-end website by 100%. Used Node.js, Selenium, and the Intern automation framework to perform this, doubling as a prototype to determine if this suite of technologies would best suit the company,or if an alternative approach would offer greater benefit.

experience.title: Academic Coach
experience.description: Helped in the grading of assignments and tutoring for Computer Science courses offered at Neumont University. Offered mentoring for underclassmen struggling in these classes and consulted with the instructor of the class to try to inform them of the state of the class, and what could possibly be done to help the class as a whole.

education.description: Studied Computer Science and Software Development. Learned current industry best practices and trends, along with the other core skills such as OOP, database design and development, software design, and software engineering principles.

education.degree: No degree, Electrical, Electronic and Communications Engineering Technology/Technician
education.field_of_study: Electrical, Electronic and Communications Engineering Technology/Technician
education.description: Attended during high school as part of a concurrent enrollment program offered by my high school in partnership with Rogue Community College.
education.fieldOfStudy: Electrical, Electronic and Communications Engineering Technology/Technician

projects.name: StatusPoint
projects.description: StatusPoint is an application that runs in a car dealership's service department. It's purpose is to display the status of ongoing repairs in a specific shop of the dealership for their customers. The application was built using ASP.NET WepApi 2 and served up as a OWIN microservice that communicates with AutoPoint's core services to interface with their database.

projects.name: QA Automated Funtional Testing Framework
projects.description:
Prototyped a functional UI integration testing framework using Node.js, Selenium Server, and the Intern automation framework. Using user stories, created tests that verified the core functionality of 1800-CONTACTS' front facing website. Served as a tech spike of sorts for the web development team to determine the feasibility of using this particular combination of technologies for their production system.

Technologies:
- Node.js
- Selenium Server
- Python
- Grunt 
- Sauce Labs
